quality-documents.title: Temperature excursion management
quality-documents.author: María México
quality-documents.purpose: Define consistent assessment, containment and documentation of temperature excursions.
quality-documents.scope: Manufacturing lines, controlled storage and connected temperature sensors at the Ate plant.
quality-documents.procedure: Quarantine affected materials, record duration and maximum temperature, assess product impact and request QA disposition.
quality-documents.revisionSummary: Adds IoT evidence linkage and a 30-minute escalation threshold.

quality-documents.title: Line clearance
quality-documents.author: Alberto Valle
quality-documents.purpose: Ensure each line is cleared before a new batch.
quality-documents.scope: Every manufacturing line of the Ate plant.

audit-findings.title: Calibration records
audit-findings.observation: Supplier temperature probe calibration certificates were not available for two instruments.
audit-findings.response: Calibration register attached; signed certificates requested from the supplier.
audit-findings.closureRequirement: Independent reviewer verifies current certificates and traceable calibration dates.

audit-findings.title: Training coverage
audit-findings.observation: Two operators had no record of SOP-QA-014 training.

audit-findings.title: Document retention
audit-findings.observation: Retention period not stated in two records.
